reasons: All five must-take courses are planned, plus only the required prerequisites CS3241 for CS4247, CS2105 and CS2107 for CS3235, and CS2111 for CS3249.
Prerequisites are satisfied in strictly earlier semesters: CS3241 before CS4247, CS2105 and CS2107 before CS3235, and CS2111 before CS3249.
The plan uses the minimum 3 semesters: CS2111 is Sem 2 only and CS3249 is Sem 1 only, so CS3249 cannot be earlier than semester 7; 9 courses at max 3 per semester require exactly 3 semesters.
Each used semester has 3 modules, so workload is evenly spread; a lighter final semester would require a fourth semester and conflicts with the fewest-semesters priority.
